instNote: ﻿Last June, 5 professed sisters were sent from this community to establish a foundation of their order in the city of St. Louis. Amongst the various spiritual and corporal works of mercy, those peculiarly characteristic of this institution are, "Instruction of Poor Girls"; "Visitation of the Sick"; and "Protection of Young Women of Good Character". In the House of Mercy adjoining the convent, one hundred poor girls are supported and protected until placed in situations. Above two hundred and fifty poor children daily attend the schools. The sisters visit the sick and dying poor every day, also Belleview Hospital and the City Prison twice a week. Adults, requiring religious instruction, are daily attended to in the institution.
